summary.text: Gerald Boursiquot is the Democratic candidate for California State Assembly District 75 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Carl DeMaio.
He is an IT professional who served in the U.S. Air Force from 2008 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Gerald Boursiquot earned a high school diploma from Ramapo High School, an associate degree from Alliance College in 1998 and a bachelor's degree from the ITT Technical Institute in 2015.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in Spring Valley, New York, to Haitian immigrant parents, retired from the Air Force after 22 years and has lived in North County San Diego since 2014.
Boursiquot advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary.
In the survey, he said his first key message is to expand housing access and tackle homelessness.
